hero.title: File:Blodveien.jpg
hero.description: A war memorial over the lost war prisoners who were used as slave labour to build the Blood road. Mostly Soviet and Yugoslaw prisoners. Located at the Arctic Circle where E6 is passing by. Text on the memorial: This road was built by Yugoslav prisoners of war during the Nazi-regime 42-45, many lost their lives in the process...

gallery.title: File:Blodkorset at Blodveien.JPG
gallery.description: The cross drawn on the rock face at Blodveien in Saltdal in Norway. The cross was originally painted with the blood of war prisoner Milos Banjac after he was shot by a Wehrmacht soldier. His brother painted the cross. The event gave the name to this stretch of the European route E 6. Today the cross is marked with paint.

gallery.title: File:Release of Botn POW camp.JPG
gallery.credit: The photographer Ingard Marcussen lived in Saltdal, Norway, and died in 1968. Saltdal kommune received all his photographs in 1990.
gallery.description: In may/june 1945 the POW camp in Botn, Saltdal, Norway, was liberated. Lots of peoples from the village have come to see the camp when it was opened and the russian soldiers was released.
